# YouTube

> YouTube is a global video platform empowering creators and viewers through content sharing, monetization, and community engagement.

YouTube serves as a comprehensive ecosystem for video creators, rightsholders, and viewers. The platform provides educational resources, copyright management tools, and transparent policies while supporting creator monetization through the YouTube Partner Program and premium services like YouTube TV and Music.

## Key Topics

- YouTube Partner Program
- Creator Monetization
- Copyright Management
- Community Guidelines
- Content Policies
- YouTube TV
- YouTube Music
- Digital Wellbeing
- Rightsholders
- Copyright Protection
- Content Management Suite
- Creator Education
- Platform Transparency
- Google Account

## Creator Resources & Education

- [YouTube Creators - Education & Inspiration for Video Creators](https://www.youtube.com/creators): Creator hub offering education, guides, and monetization resources for video creators at all levels.
- [How YouTube Works: Giving Everyone a Voice](https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks): Platform overview explaining YouTube's mission, values, and how it operates as a global video community.

## Policies & Copyright Management

- [YouTube Policies Crafted for Openness - How YouTube Works](https://www.youtube.com/about/policies): Overview of YouTube's community guidelines and content policies designed for platform safety and openness.
- [Copyright Tools: Rightsholders and Creators - How YouTube Works](https://www.youtube.com/about/copyright): Guide to YouTube's copyright protection tools, Content ID system, and content management for rightsholders and creators.

## News & Official Updates

- [Official YouTube Blog for Latest YouTube News & Insights](https://www.youtube.com/about/press): Official YouTube blog featuring news, creator profiles, industry trends, and announcements about platform updates.
- [The Exclusive Home of NFL Sunday Ticket - YouTube & YouTube TV](https://tv.youtube.com/learn/nflsundayticket): Promotional information about NFL Sunday Ticket streaming service available exclusively on YouTube TV.

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us](https://www.youtube.com/t/contact_us): Contact page with support channels and help resources for YouTube users and creators.

## Optional

- [Terms of Service](https://www.youtube.com/t/terms): YouTube Terms of Service and user agreement.
- [Privacy Policy – Privacy & Terms – Google](https://www.youtube.com/t/privacy): Google/YouTube privacy policy covering data collection and retention.
